class.name: MaszynaHeightmapTerrainPack
class.brief_description: A pack file of the original's heightmap terrain (.tch).
class.description: 16 x 16 chunks of the original's heightmap terrain (heightmap::pack_file), each a list of slices - its header, its heights, its paint - stored or zstd-compressed, with a CRC-32. Opening it reads its index; a chunk is read when asked for, on any thread.

method.name: get_key
method.description: Where the pack lies, in packs.

method.name: open
method.description: Reads the pack's index; [code]false[/code] when the file at [param path] is no pack of the version and layout the original writes.

method.name: read_chunk
method.description: The chunk of [param key] read; [code]null[/code] when the pack has none there or its data is damaged.
